description: This file defines React components for rendering markdown content with enhanced features, including math rendering with KaTeX, syntax highlighting, mermaid diagrams, copy-to-clipboard functionality, and custom rendering for code blocks and links.

classes.name: Mermaid
classes.description: React component that renders Mermaid diagrams from provided code, with error handling and the ability to view the diagram SVG in a new window.

classes.name: PreCode
classes.description: React component that processes code blocks, extracts mermaid diagrams, and renders them using the Mermaid component, with copy-to-clipboard functionality.

classes.name: _MarkDownContent
classes.description: Internal component that sanitizes and renders markdown content with math, syntax highlighting, and custom components.

classes.name: Markdown
classes.description: Main React component that displays markdown content with optional loading state, font size, and additional styling or event handlers.

methods.name: escapeDollarNumber
methods.description: Escapes dollar signs followed by numbers to prevent incorrect math rendering.

methods.name: escapeBrackets
methods.description: Transforms bracketed math expressions into LaTeX delimiters for proper rendering.
